review_scope: Main reviewer fully read all Chinese body paragraphs in this five-essay batch. Language reviewers separately read each complete assigned manuscript and Chinese source. Root read all eight corresponding full paragraphs at Growth23p14 and approved restoring affected people's opportunity to voice their own reasons in six foreign editions, not merely the actor explaining reasons. Chinese and Hant stay unchanged and explicitly verified. No argument, example or limitation is omitted; no exhaustive external empirical audit is claimed.

edits.zh: 一个方向属于自己，不表示它发生在没有别人的世界里。它可能改变共同财务、照护安排和未来计划。本人仍有最后的价值判断，却有义务让受影响的人知道事实、表达理由，并承担对方不愿继续参与的可能。
edits.hant: 一個方向屬於自己，不表示它發生在沒有別人的世界裡。它可能改變共同財務、照護安排和未來計劃。本人仍有最後的價值判斷，卻有義務讓受影響的人知道事實、表達理由，並承擔對方不願繼續參與的可能。
edits.en: A direction's being one's own does not mean it unfolds in a world without others. It may alter shared finances, care arrangements, and future plans. The person still makes the final judgment of value, but has a duty to make the facts known to those affected, give them room to voice their reasons, and accept that they may choose not to remain involved.
edits.reason: Eight-language synchronized meaning check: let affected people know the facts and express their reasons. Six foreign manuscripts omitted this opportunity by only having the actor explain reasons. Chinese and Hant already express the intended meaning and remain unchanged.
